questions.title: Shopping questions
questions.description: Questions shoppers ask AI assistants, one per line, for example 'best running shoes for flat feet'. Each question is one result.
prefill: best running shoes for flat feet
best robot vacuum for pet hair

brands.title: Brands or products to track
brands.description: Optional. Names to look for in every answer (for example your brand and your competitors). For each one you get how many answers mention it and its best position in the AI's list.

engines.title: AI assistants
engines.description: Which assistants to ask. ChatGPT uses OpenAI's API with web search, Perplexity its Sonar API, Gemini the Gemini API with Google Search, Claude Anthropic's API with web search. Each answer is charged separately.

samplesPerEngine.title: Answers per assistant
samplesPerEngine.description: AI answers vary from one ask to the next, so each assistant is asked this many times per question. A product's share is the fraction of answers that list it. Each answer is charged.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code the question is asked from, for example US or GB. ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity use it for web search; the Gemini API does not take a location.

city.title: City
city.description: Optional. A city for local questions such as 'best bike shop near me'. Used by ChatGPT and Claude.

reuseRecentAnswers.title: Reuse answers from this week
reuseRecentAnswers.description: When the same question was asked this week (ISO week, UTC), reuse those answers instead of asking again. Results are the same for everyone who asks that week. Turn off to force new answers; the price per answer is the same either way.

includeAnswerText.title: Include the answers' text
includeAnswerText.description: Add each AI answer (first 4,000 characters) and its sources to the result.

maxConcurrency.title: Questions in parallel
maxConcurrency.description: How many questions to work on at the same time.

chatgptModel.title: OpenAI model
chatgptModel.description: OpenAI model that answers with web search. Leave empty for the default (gpt-5-mini).
